coverage_notes: Primary 2024 model launch posts covered: March Claude 3 family, June Claude 3.5 Sonnet, October updated Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Claude 3.5 Haiku. March 13 Claude 3 Haiku availability post repeats launch with no new scored benchmarks in text.
Image table scores were visually transcribed from linked images on primary Anthropic posts. Comparison columns for third-party or previously released models were omitted.
Some scores have uncertain exact evaluation protocol beyond the image label; measure records only published context.
